items.title: TOZO officially launches NC9 Pro true-wireless earbuds with smart touchscreen and Hi-Res Audio
items.summary: TOZO unveiled the NC9 Pro on September 15, 2026, adding a 1.47-inch smart touchscreen charging case, LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless, AI translation/assistant features, advanced ANC and next-generation connectivity, turning the case into an interactive control center.

items.title: Oppo Enco X4 TWS earbuds confirmed for September 22 global launch with AI translation and Dynaudio tuning
items.summary: Oppo's Enco X4 flagship earbuds debut globally on September 22 with AI-powered real-time translation, a coaxial dual-driver system co-developed with Dynaudio, a dual DAC, 4K-class lossless transmission (up to 400% faster) and a 6nm AI noise-cancellation chip.

items.title: Sony announces 4th-generation DWX digital wireless microphone system with 32-bit float recording
items.summary: Sony introduced the DWT-B40 bodypack transmitter and DWR-R40Q rack receiver on September 9, simplifying channel setup while boosting RF stability; the transmitter adds built-in 32-bit float recording, +48V phantom power and timecode sync for broadcast and live events.

items.title: Anker Soundcore enters OTC hearing-aid market with first AI hearing aids at IFA 2026
items.summary: Anker debuted its first over-the-counter hearing aids at IFA 2026, powered by the proprietary THUS AI chip with a six-sensor array (four high-SNR mics plus two bone-conduction sensors) for clear voice pickup in noise; the receiver-in-canal device targets 12 hours per charge.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds receive FDA clearance for built-in OTC hearing-aid feature
items.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Buds Hearing Aid feature won FDA clearance, letting compatible earbuds run a five-minute clinical-grade hearing test and deliver personalized amplification via NAL-NL2 for adults with mild-to-moderate loss, rolling out to Galaxy Buds3 Pro and Buds4 Pro in Q4 2026.

items.title: KEF previews next-generation LS LUXE active wireless speakers with Velocity Control Technology
items.summary: KEF hosted a free listening event on September 17, 2026 for the LS LUXE active wireless speakers, pairing its Uni-Q driver and MAT absorption with Ross Lovegrove industrial design and introducing Velocity Control Technology (VECO) for the first time in a KEF speaker.

items.title: Harman Luxury Audio previews CEDIA Expo 2026 lineup: JBL Synthesis SCL series and ARCAM Radia AVA
items.summary: At CEDIA Expo 2026 (Sept 1-4, Denver) Harman Luxury Audio showed the full JBL Synthesis SCL Custom Loudspeaker lineup including its first on-wall model, the SCL-9XL, plus the 24-channel SDP-70 processor with Dirac ART and ARCAM's new 50th-anniversary Radia AVA Series.

items.title: Fraunhofer IIS and Airoha showcase high-data-rate multichannel spatial audio at MWC 2026
items.summary: Fraunhofer IIS and Airoha presented a next-generation wireless spatial-audio solution combining Fraunhofer's LC3plus codec and Cingo rendering with Airoha's flagship AB1595 Bluetooth SoC, enabling HD, low-latency multichannel audio for premium headsets and XR.

items.title: Spotify and Universal Music let Premium users create AI covers and remixes
items.summary: At Investor Day 2026 Spotify struck a licensing deal with Universal Music Group to let Premium subscribers generate AI-powered covers and remixes of licensed songs as a paid add-on, with artist consent, credit and compensation; new AI podcast tools were also announced.

items.title: Hollyland unveils LARK A2 and LARK M3 wireless mics plus 4K streaming gear at IFA 2026
items.summary: At IFA 2026 Hollyland debuted the 8.5g LARK A2 with three-level AI noise cancellation and 48kHz/24-bit capture, and the LARK M3 supporting up to four transmitters and four receivers for independent four-track recording, alongside the VenusLiv Air 2 4K60 streaming camera.
